item.text:
Audited each Roman verse against the Urdu in [meri-zainab-gham-se.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/2/workspaces/78d67480021746d5b5fe7759de44b46f/src/data/lyrics/meri-zainab-gham-se.md). Corrected supported wording, nasal endings, vowel spellings, and proper-name capitalization. The Urdu text, metadata, and verse order were preserved.

Three unclear Urdu readings still need editorial sign-off. I retained the existing Roman readings for `مانجای`, `ان جانا`, and `جاتل`.
